slots.fullPrompt: Какой простой механизм использует колесо с канавкой и гибкий канат?
slots.fullNote: В идеальной системе с параллельными несущими ветвями их натяжение одинаково. Учитывают каждую ветвь, поддерживающую груз, даже если она также меняет направление тяги; не учитывают ветвь, которая лишь перенаправляет тягу и груз не поддерживает.

promptSpecificGrounds.fact: Pulley uses a grooved wheel and rope to move a load.
Pulley is a grooved-wheel/cord mechanism; rotation of its wheel moves the cord linearly.

slots.variantJudgment: Ключ: определение в вопросе совпадает с механизмом, использующим grooved wheel and rope; иные варианты по источнику имеют иную конструкцию/операцию.

variantPrimaryGrounds.fact: A pulley is specifically the grooved-wheel-and-rope simple machine.

noteClaims.fact: IMA excludes friction, while AMA is actual; supports labeling an idealized model, but does not itself state equal tension.
Mechanical advantage is determined by the strands supporting the load; source says not to count the strand that allows direction change.
Explicitly distinguishes strands supporting the load from strands that only change force direction.

slots.noteAssessment: Each factual clause in this note is supported by the cited locator(s); it adds an answer-specific fact and does not repeat the prompt definition.
slots.noteInferenceAndLimits: Equal tension in parallel load-supporting segments is explicitly an ideal-model inference, not a quotation or direct sentence in Yale. It follows under the stated frictionless idealization and the parallel-strand condition; if that derivation is not accepted as adequately sourced, mark this note HOLD rather than treating the source as verbatim support. The wording explicitly includes a direction-changing strand when it also supports load and excludes only the redirect-only strand.

promptSpecificGrounds.fact: Question requires grooved wheel and rope.

slots.variantJudgment: Наклонная плоскость выглядит правдоподобно как механизм выигрыша в силе, но описанная конструкция не является наклонной поверхностью с перемещением груза.

variantPrimaryGrounds.fact: Inclined plane is a slanted surface over which the load moves.
Contrasts that with grooved wheel and rope.

noteClaims.fact: At fixed vertical height, IMA is length of incline divided by its height.
A different incline length may be compared while keeping height fixed.

slots.noteAssessment: Each factual clause in this note is supported by the cited locator(s); it adds an answer-specific fact and does not repeat the prompt definition.

slots.fullPrompt: Какой простой механизм использует колесо с канавкой и гибкий канат?
slots.fullNote: Отвёртка и дверная ручка — примеры применения этого механизма.

promptSpecificGrounds.fact: Grooved wheel and rope define the asked construction.

slots.variantJudgment: Колесо и ось — близкий и потому правдоподобный distractor из той же группы машин; оно требует двух соединённых круглых деталей/зафиксированного колеса и оси, тогда как prompt требует канат в канавке.

variantPrimaryGrounds.fact: Wheel and axle consists of two connected circular objects, larger wheel and smaller axle.
In a wheel-and-axle, wheel is locked to its central axle.
Pulley instead uses grooved wheel and rope.

noteClaims.fact: Source gives screwdriver and doorknob as wheel-and-axle examples.

slots.noteAssessment: Each factual clause in this note is supported by the cited locator(s); it adds an answer-specific fact and does not repeat the prompt definition.

slots.fullPrompt: Какой простой механизм использует колесо с канавкой и гибкий канат?
slots.fullNote: Во втором классе нагрузка находится между опорой и приложенным усилием; такая схема умножает силу.

promptSpecificGrounds.fact: Grooved wheel and rope define the asked construction.

slots.variantJudgment: Рычаг — правдоподобная простая машина, но его определяет жёсткий стержень с опорой, а не канат на канавчатом колесе.

variantPrimaryGrounds.fact: Lever is a stiff rod rotating around a fulcrum; outcomes depend on the fulcrum and input/output positions.

noteClaims.fact: In a second-class lever the load arm lies between fulcrum and effort arm, and this class multiplies force.

slots.noteAssessment: Each factual clause in this note is supported by the cited locator(s); it adds an answer-specific fact and does not repeat the prompt definition.

facts.fact: Fixed pulley redirects force; movable pulley multiplies force; block-and-tackle combines force multiplication and redirection.
Ideal advantage relates to supporting strands; strands that only redirect force are distinguished from those supporting the load.
Ideal-vs-actual distinction: friction is excluded in IMA.

explanationClaims.qualification: Equal tension under parallel, ideal, frictionless load-supporting strands is a derived mechanics inference; it is not presented as a verbatim source assertion.

variantPrimaryGrounds.fact: Lever uses a stiff rod and fulcrum, not a coupled wheel and axle.

noteClaims.fact: Second-class lever places the load between fulcrum and effort and multiplies force.

slots.noteAssessment: Each factual clause in this note is supported by the cited locator(s); it adds an answer-specific fact and does not repeat the prompt definition.
